articles.title: Yen stablecoin issuer JPYC’s Series B reaches $38M
articles.description: JPYC said it plans to use the new capital to expand its financial and Web3 ecosystem and accelerate adoption of its yen-pegged token.

articles.title: Bitcoin-backed loan refinances PowerCompute’s $18M debt at 2%
articles.description: Nasdaq-listed PowerCompute refinanced $18 million of debt through a Bitcoin-backed facility carrying an initial interest rate of about 2%.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs pull in $244M, 3-day inflow streak tops $626M
articles.description: US-listed Bitcoin ETFs attracted $244.4 million on Wednesday, marking three consecutive inflow days for a combined $626 million.

articles.title: EU watchdogs warn of impersonation scams amid MiCA licensing shakeout

articles.title: Fed’s Cook says she’d support rate hike if disinflation stalls
articles.description: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said she is “prepared to act” if inflation remains too high above the Fed’s target rate.

articles.title: ElizaOS token sinks 19% to record low after founder declares it ‘dead’
articles.description: Eliza Labs founder Shaw Walters said the project transferred its remaining treasury to settle a tokenholder lawsuit and will continue building Eliza without an associated cryptocurrency.

articles.title: Meta latest AI firm to see model go rogue during testing

articles.title: Block raises 2026 outlook on strong quarter, says AI touches nearly all code

articles.title: Mysten Labs tech chief joins Anthropic to work on AI security

articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team reports 5K findings in sweeping security audit

articles.title: Senator Warren questions US AI chip policy after Trump crypto investment: Report

articles.title: Senator Lummis still pushing for CLARITY vote before August recess

articles.title: Marex invests in Digital Prime to expand institutional crypto lending
articles.description: The undisclosed investment will support the development of Tokenet, a digital asset lending platform, as institutional demand for crypto infrastructure continues to grow.

articles.title: Western Union brings stablecoin remittances to Visa network with Stablecard

articles.title: Crypto whales accumulate as bear market nears late stage: CryptoQuant
articles.description: Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP whales increased balances during market weakness, as CryptoQuant said large holders are absorbing supply ahead of a possible bottom.

articles.title: Galaxy reports $85M net loss amid Q2 crypto market slump

articles.title: Mastercard, Borderless test shared identity checks for stablecoin transfers

articles.title: Binance sues RedotPay over alleged $473 million user losses: Report

articles.title: Circle Q2 revenue falls short of Wall Street estimates

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs log inflows as cold wallet hack reignites custody debate

articles.title: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating
articles.description: The rating recognizes the fund’s ability to maintain a stable net asset value, while S&P separately reaffirmed USDT among the lowest-rated stablecoins under its existing assessment framework.

articles.title: Bitcoin price-metric basket sees longest capitulation since FTX blow-up: Glassnode

articles.title: Forgd brings its crypto market-maker leaderboard to DefiLlama
articles.description: Forgd’s ratings draw on data from more than 500 token projects and 35 market-making firms, but do not solely reflect trading performance.

articles.title: Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias close European crypto merger
